login.title: Chiteshi Mudiwa Pinda
login.welcome: Tinoashira kupetuka! Nyoresa kuti utarisire vanotungamira.
login.heroTitle: Kura bhizinesi rako rekutengesa dzimba nekutungamira kwese kwaunounza
login.heroIntro: Imweni portal yekunyoresa vatengi nevavaki, chengeta chikwereti chevatungamiri vako uye uvatevere kuburikidza nekubhuka.

register.title: Nyoresa inotungamira mumasekonzi .
register.text: Tumira mutengi wako uye chirongwa chavanofarira.

protect.title: Kudzivirirwa kwekudzokorora .
protect.text: Kutungamira kwako kunogara kwako kwenguva yekudzivirirwa, saka hapana umweni unokwanisa kutora mutengi mumwe chete.

track.title: Rondedzera chikamu chega chega .
track.text: Ona chimiro chemutungamiri umwe neumwe uye nhoroondo yakadzara, kubva pakutanga kubatana kusvika pakubhuka.

handover.title: Chikwereti pakubhuka .
handover.text: Kana mutsigiri abhukura, lead inopiwa kune muvaki newe wakanyorwa se source partner.

login.secure: Kuchengeteka kupinda - ruzivo rwevatengi vako rwugare rwakavanzika
